artifact_isolation_note: The ledger archive stages only the checkpoint, evidence, decision, and self-neutral receipt. Concurrent modifications to the three producer working copies are explicitly excluded and remain uncommitted.
validation_note: Checkpoint, evidence, and decision parse with duplicate-key rejection and encode exactly one next action, REVISE, active goal status, and no experiment authorization. Full committed-tree validation is performed after the isolated archive commit because unrelated post-snapshot producer drift makes the shared mutable tree intentionally noncanonical.
note: Self-neutral ledger receipt; the queue binds the resulting commit and receipt hash after commit.
